name: opensky Secured Visa

apr.notes: Cash advance fee $6 or 5%, whichever is greater. Late payment fee up to $41. Terms accurate as of 01/14/2026.

credit_required.notes: Secured card. A refundable security deposit equal to the credit line funds a Pledged Deposit Account (no interest paid); after one year the cardholder may request a credit limit decrease to no less than $200.
